title: Book Babies Storytime
description: Book Babies Storytime Book Babies Storytime @ Lumpkin Lumpkin County Library Branch It’s never too early to chew on a good book! This program is designed for babies (along with parent(s)) from birth to 18 months . We’ll be creating building blocks of early literacy through songs, action rhymes, books, and playtime. These are wonderful times for your babies to hear lots of language, and a great opportunity for you to meet new parents! (Structured activity for 15 minutes with playtime after). title: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting
description: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting Dahlonega Woman's Club Meetings All women of Dahlonega/Lumpkin County are welcome to join Dahlonega Woman's Club, a charitable service organization of women dedicated to strengthening the Dahlonega/Lumpkin County community and enriching lives through volunteer service and fundraising. The club meets at the historic Community House, 111 N. Park Street, Dahlonega, on the first Thursday of every month, except July and December. title: Authors in the Evening at the Library!
description: Authors in the Evening at the Library! The Friends of Lumpkin County Library will be hosting the next speaker in the series, “Authors in the Afternoon Evening" (6pm!). This is a free series of presentations by authors who will be on hand at the library to talk about their writing. The author gives a presentation followed by a Q & A session. Books may also be signed or purchased from the author as well. title: The Game Show Dahlonega
description: The Game Show Dahlonega The Game Show Dahlonega is back at the Historic Holly Theatre, and this time, it’s Faculty vs. Students! Join Planet Acorn’s Bobby Youngblood for a hilarious night of live game-show fun as students from Lumpkin County High School take on their teachers in a battle of quick thinking, unexpected answers, school spirit, and plenty of laughs. Inspired by classic game shows like Family Feud and Let’s Make a Deal , Game Show Dahlonega puts local personalities in the spotlight as they compete through a series of games and challenges.
